lead: A new `nvs_types::ty::Ty` variant compiles after one arm, and the sites that must learn it are the ones the compiler never names.
body: `Ty` is `#[non_exhaustive]`, so every match outside the crate carries a `_` already and inside it only `equality_domain` is exhaustive: the isolate entry refusal, `check_expr`'s `wants_callable`, `generics`' two walks and `nvs_ir::lower::erase_checked_ty` each took their wildcard in silence. Grep the neighbour the new variant behaves like and decide every hit by hand before believing a green build.
